subject: prd/prd-review
statement: The reviewer shall read severity defaults from a versioned calibration table held as data — coherence and alignment default blocking; contract-quality advisory unless a Must row becomes unverifiable; critic findings blocking only when load-bearing for §8 — and every finding shall cite the calibration row it applied.
rationale: the anti-nitpick dial must be tunable data, not prose (— #D-5; AP-10/AP-21)
fit_criterion: the table exists, versioned; 100% of findings cite their calibration row; changing a row changes behavior with no guide edit
